name: bg-bubbles
title: Bubbles Background
description: A full-bleed animated backdrop of about two hundred and fifty soft-edged spheres in blue, green and yellow, floating in front of a very large pale sphere, with a slow warm-to-cool colour shift.
use: A hero or section needs a playful drifting field of bubbles behind its copy.
avoid: It renders continuously in WebGL, and the blur prop also blurs every child, text included.
a11y: Decorative WebGL canvas with no reduced-motion check, and the blur prop softens any child content including text. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bright blue gradient sky fills the frame behind one huge pale sphere. Many smaller spheres in blue, mint green and yellow float at different depths, and centred white text sits slightly softened over the field.
behaves: Every bubble bobs up and down and the whole palette slowly warms toward orange and cools back to blue on a repeating cycle. The scene stays running while it is mounted and resizes with its parent.
customise: blur softens the overlay and children render on top; bubble count, both palettes, camera distance and bob speed are constants in the source.
weight: heavy: About 250 shaded spheres plus a full-screen sphere, re-rendered every frame in WebGL.
demo: The heading 'Bubbles Background' over the line 'A three.js animated gradient bubble scene'.
issues: The blur prop blurs the whole child layer, so in the frames the heading and subtitle are smeared.
White text sits on bright bubbles with little contrast, making the caption hard to read.
polishWhy: Soft, pleasant bubbles; flat shading and a blur washing over the demo text keep it ordinary.
